lineage.strategy: Add financing evidence tied directly to contracted GPU infrastructure rather than repeat capacity announcements.

observations.fact: Nebius announced an approximately $775 million senior secured facility backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows, maturing October 31, 2030 at SOFR + 2.50%; it said the facility plus customer cash flows covers more than 100% of capex for the underlying deployment.

risks.risk: Secured financing adds leverage and depends on contracted cash flows and underlying infrastructure performance.

unknowns.unknown: Facility covenants, utilization schedule and consolidated leverage effects require separate filing-level underwriting.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed financing/capital-efficiency evidence; Alpha should source filing-level leverage and covenant details before numeric scoring.
